question: Which of the following places in India experiences the lowest temperature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leh experiences the lowest temperature in India due to its high altitude and proximity to the Himalayas.**
 
• The average temperature in Leh during winter can drop to -20 degrees Celsius.
 
• Leh is a city in the disputed Kashmir region of Ladakh, which is administered by India.
 
• **It is Ladakh's largest city and joint capital. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jaisalmer experiences extreme heat during summers with temperatures soaring above 45 degrees Celsius.
 
• Munnar is a hill station in Kerala.
 
 
• **It experiences moderate temperatures throughout the year.**
 
 
 
• Bundelkhand is a region spanning across Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh.
 
 
• **It experiences hot and dry summers with temperatures rising above 40 degrees Celsius.**
